title: Computing Strong Rank-Revealing Factorizations for Matrices with Orthonormal Rows
summary: We show that a pivoting strategy due to Stewart (based on work by Bischof) computes a strong rank-revealing factorization when applied to a matrix with orthonormal rows. When paired with the classical column selection algorithm of Golub, Klema, and Stewart (GKS) it helps achieve rank-$k$ approximation accuracy bounds and basis conditioning as good as those from applying a strong rank-revealing factorization directly to A.
